[element-issn-l]
=== `<issn-l>` ISSN-L (Linking ISSN) (in a citation)

Within a citation (such as a <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>> or an <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>), an ISSN designated by an ISSN Centre to group together the different media versions of a standards document. Since a single ISSN-L is assigned no matter how many media formats of a work there are, the ISSN-L can be used to link among the different media versions of the standards document or continuing resource, for example, both the printed and online versions of the same standards document.
